estimate_label: Experiment Version 2 — Development CV Estimate — CatBoost multiclass comparison
search: 24 preregistered randomized joint recipes per arm, balanced marginal coverage without a Cartesian grid. All four arms share identical tree settings, folds, seeds and budgets. Custom class weights vary independently per class.
weighting: Native CatBoost no weighting, auto_class_weights=Balanced, auto_class_weights=SqrtBalanced, or explicit six-class custom class_weights. Automatic weights use the current training fold only: max(n_class)/n_class or its square root. Preserve native weight scale; do not combine policies or normalize them. Verify effective fitted weights from get_all_params after every fit. No precomputed global weights or scale_pos_weight.
selection: Highest unweighted mean inner fixed-six-class sklearn Macro F1 per arm; exact ties by candidate order. Native MultiClass loss is the training objective, not a substitute for sklearn Macro F1 model selection.
early_stopping: Disabled. No eval_set, use_best_model=False; iteration count selected inside inner CV.
preprocessing: Numeric schema validation and native CatBoost on raw features; borders and trees learned inside each fit. No scaling, resampling, feature engineering, external Pool/borders, calibration or threshold tuning.
score_policy: Unweighted validation metrics. Native six-class probabilities and decoded labels. Macro PR-AUC is macro OvR average precision; fold ranking scores are never pooled across fitted models.
runtime_policy: Serial one-thread CPU execution, separate inner search/outer fit/prediction/scoring timings. Historical reference runtimes are retained from their original runs, not remeasured or universal speed ratios.

reference_provenance.note: Saved development-only OOF results. No benchmark refit during CatBoost study.
Saved development-only OOF results. No benchmark refit during CatBoost study.

comparison_policy: Compare all four CatBoost arms with fixed LDA-SMOTE, tuned SVM and all three tuned XGBoost arms. Reuse checksum-verified OOF predictions on exactly matching development source rows and outer/inner folds. Search budgets differ across model families; compare declared procedures, not equal-budget family optima. SVM average precision uses decision scores, other models use native probabilities.
limitations: Finite search on already explored development data. Overlapping folds give descriptive SD, not confidence intervals. Retrospectively choosing the highest outer mean adds an unevaluated selection step. No model promotion or new test claim.

environment.outer_cv: sequential; estimator/search parallelism recorded in parameters
